title: Ron's Crafts And Addons
description: Adds new potion effects and recipes as long as 2 new farming items
body:
Ron's Crafts And Addons is a mod that adds 2 new items, lots of potion recipes and 2 new potions! The mod was made in Mcreator and supposed to be downloaded with Some Assembely Required

**Doesn't Requires any mods**

## New Items:
### The "Holy Milk"

An item that is made up of a milk bucket and honey and is used for making the cure potion as long as being able to turn block into others with the downside of losing durability!

<details>
<summary>List of block turnable:</summary>

- Dirt > Grass Block
- Dirt with Mushroom Stem above it > Mycelium
- Netherrack with Nether Wart Block above it > Crimson Nylium
- Netherrack with Warped Wart Block above it > Warped Nylium
- Diorite > Calcite
</details>

### The "Dark Milk"

An item that is made up of a milk bucket, rotten flesh and soul sand and is used for making the junk potion as long as being able to turn block into others with the downside of losing durability!

<details>
<summary>List of block turnable:</summary>

- Stone > Deepslate
- Cobblestone > Cobbled Deepslate
- Deepslate > Blackstone
- Blackstone > Obsidian
- Andesite > Tuff
</details>

## New Potion Effects:
### The "Purification" potion effect which removes all bad potion effects!

After the effect ends the player takes 12 damage

<details>
<summary>Bad effects included</summary>

- Blindness
- Darkness
- Hunger
- Infested
- Instant Damage
- Mining Fatige
- Nausea
- Oozing
- Poison
- Slowness
- Unluck
- Weakness
- Weaving
- Wind Charged
- Wither

</details>

### The "Shady" potion effect which removes all good potion effects!

After the effect ends the player takes 12 damage


<details>
<summary>Good effects included:</summary>

- Purification
- Absorption
- Conduit Power
- Dolphin's Grace
- Fire Resistance
- Glowing
- Haste
- Health Boost
- Hero Of The Village
- Instant Health
- Invisablity
- Jump Boost
- Levitation
- Luck
- Night Vision
- Regeneration
- Resistance
- Speed
- Slow Falling
- Strength
- Water Breathing

</details>

## All of the new recipes for the new potion
Including Potion of Cure, Potion of Junk, Potion of Haste and Potion of Levitaion

<details>
<summary>New potion recipes (All the recipes in a brewing stand):</summary>

- Potion of Cure - Gives the purification effect - Holy Milk into an Awkward Potion
- Potion of Junk - Gives the shady effect - Dark Milk into an Awkward Potion
- Potion of Haste - Gold Pickaxe into an Awkward Potion
- Potion of Levitaion - Shulker Shell into an Awkward Potion

</details>

## New Advencments:
- Miracle Max: Obtaining Holy Milk
- Don't Deal With The Devil: obtaining Dark Milk
